scope: Disposable Kind v1.36.1 cluster. Creates an owned namespace, one digest-pinned synthetic mock workload, a default-deny NetworkPolicy, and a named-object read-only Role. Captures API-visible posture, detects controlled changes to Pod Security Admission labels, NetworkPolicy rules and Role verbs, reapplies the desired manifests, and verifies recovery from live API reads. Joins an offline fictional advisory fixture to a synthetic component observation. Pinned offline OSV-Scanner reads the inert package metadata in a case-built runnable image, and the posture result binds to the exact image observed in Kind. Benchmark coverage, actual advisory feeds, managed and accelerator settings, and deployed monitoring and alerting have separate evidence requirements. A scoped authenticated Role stream compares fixture metadata updates, rule widening and restoration with exact API event revisions.

checks.claim: Owned resources begin at the declared restricted baseline
Offline fictional component metadata joins exactly and the version near miss stays unmatched
Posture assessment detects each controlled owned-resource regression
Reapplying the owned desired state restores API-observed posture
Changes outside the explicitly owned fixture scope do not alter its assessment
Pinned OSV result is bound through the preserved OCI subject to a Pod that ran the image in the owned namespace
Missing, failed, misbound and unknown scanner evidence never becomes a healthy posture result
The disposable registry container and volume were removed
Named Role list and watch succeed while unfiltered and different-name watches receive 403
Live Role watch distinguishes metadata, policy widening and restored policy on one UID
